notes: S1 from the previous verdict is resolved. PolicyService.RecordNumberedClaim builds RecordedClaim(claim.Value, policy.Claims.Count, policy.HasClaims) from the in-memory claim before SaveChanges and does no re-read afterwards. The controller answers from that object. The claim number and HasClaims cannot come from another request's claim. A concurrent write on the same policy still gets 409, because SaveChanges sets a new Version and PolicyConfiguration marks Version with IsConcurrencyToken.

API3: the request DTOs are CancelPolicyRequest (optional CancellationDate only) and RecordClaimRequest (ClaimDate and Description only). Both are separate from the domain and EF types. The client cannot set HasClaims, refund or payment references, Cancellation, EndDate or Version. The responses carry no Version or internal ids. The claim reference is derived as CLM-{policy}-{n}.

API4: Description has [MaxLength(500)] on the DTO constructor parameter and HasMaxLength(500) on the column. Refund and payment references are capped at 40 and RuleApplied at 20. The three new routes have the following limits. POST cancellation and POST claims carry [EnableRateLimiting("writes")]. The GET quote falls under the global limiter. No list endpoint was added. The body limit and limiter setup are untouched in this diff.

API6 double-cancel: Policy.Quote runs ValidateCancellationDate, which returns a CANCEL-4 Conflict when Cancellation is set, for both Cancel and Quote. Cancel now applies Quote's decision, so the two cannot drift apart. The Cancellation row is unique per policy. Version is regenerated whenever a claim or cancellation is added, so a concurrent double-cancel, or a cancel racing a claim, gets 409.

API6 refund integrity: RefundCalculator gives term.Amount * unusedDays / termDays, with usedDays clamped to [0, termDays], so a refund is never above term.Amount or negative. It rounds once, through Money.Round. A refund is created only for a term with a payment and an amount above 0, and it reverses that payment's method and reference. A claim or an unpaid term gives 0. Caveat for a later renew node: refund-at-most-paid relies on payment.Amount equalling term.Amount, as SELL-6 sets it.
API6 quote: PolicyService.Quote calls no SaveChanges. Policy.Quote mutates nothing, and the single UK today is passed in once per request.

API8: UnexpectedExceptionHandler is untouched. Grep found no UseDeveloperExceptionPage, Exception.Message or StackTrace use, and no Password= or AccountKey=. Nothing secret is in the src diff. The new problem titles are static.

API9: the three new routes, POST cancellation, GET cancellation-quote and POST claims, are the E3 to E5 routes. gate.stubs found no NotImplementedException in src/. gate.run shows the live happy paths and the Postman F3 Cancel run with 0 failures.
